description.en: Place N queens on an N x N chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. A queen can attack horizontally, vertically, and diagonally. Print all distinct solutions where each solution is a permutation representing the column position of the queen in each row.
description.hi: N queens ko N x N chessboard pe aise place karo ki koi bhi do queens ek dusre ko attack na kar sakein. Queen horizontally, vertically, aur diagonally attack kar sakti hai. Saare distinct solutions print karo jahan har solution ek permutation hai jo har row mein queen ki column position batata hai.

explanation.en: For a 4x4 board, there are 2 valid arrangements. In [2,4,1,3]: Queen in row 1 is at column 2, row 2 at column 4, row 3 at column 1, row 4 at column 3.
explanation.hi: 4x4 board ke liye 2 valid arrangements hain. [2,4,1,3] mein: Row 1 ki queen column 2 pe, row 2 ki column 4 pe, row 3 ki column 1 pe, row 4 ki column 3 pe hai.

hints.en: Place queens one row at a time and check column, left diagonal, and right diagonal conflicts
hints.hi: Ek row at a time queen place karo aur column, left diagonal, aur right diagonal conflicts check karo

hints.en: Use three arrays/sets to track occupied columns and diagonals
hints.hi: Teen arrays/sets use karo occupied columns aur diagonals track karne ke liye

description.en: Given an N x N maze where 1 represents an open cell and 0 represents a blocked cell, find all paths for a rat to travel from the top-left corner (0,0) to the bottom-right corner (N-1, N-1). The rat can move in four directions: Up (U), Down (D), Left (L), Right (R).
description.hi: Ek N x N maze diya hai jahan 1 open cell hai aur 0 blocked cell hai. Chuhe ke liye saare paths dhundho top-left corner (0,0) se bottom-right corner (N-1, N-1) tak. Chuha chaar directions mein move kar sakta hai: Up (U), Down (D), Left (L), Right (R).

explanation.en: Two paths exist from (0,0) to (3,3). DDRDRR means Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right.
explanation.hi: Do paths hain (0,0) se (3,3) tak. DDRDRR ka matlab Down, Down, Right, Down, Right, Right.

hints.en: Use a visited matrix to avoid revisiting cells
hints.hi: Visited matrix use karo cells ko dubara visit karne se bachne ke liye

hints.en: At each cell, try all 4 directions and backtrack if it leads to a dead end
hints.hi: Har cell pe chaaon directions try karo aur dead end pe backtrack karo

approach.en: Recursively explore all four directions from each cell. Use a visited matrix to avoid cycles. If destination is reached, store the path string.
approach.hi: Har cell se recursively chaaon directions explore karo. Cycles se bachne ke liye visited matrix use karo. Agar destination pahunch gaye toh path string store karo.

problems.title: Sudoku Solver

description.en: Given a partially filled 9x9 Sudoku grid, fill in the empty cells (represented by 0) such that every row, every column, and every 3x3 sub-box contains the digits 1 to 9 exactly once.
description.hi: Ek partially filled 9x9 Sudoku grid diya hai, empty cells (jo 0 se represent hoti hain) ko aise bharo ki har row, har column, aur har 3x3 sub-box mein digits 1 se 9 exactly ek baar aayein.

explanation.en: Each empty cell is filled such that no digit repeats in any row, column, or 3x3 box.
explanation.hi: Har empty cell ko aise bhara jata hai ki koi digit kisi row, column, ya 3x3 box mein repeat na ho.

constraints: Input will always have a valid solution

hints.en: Find an empty cell, try digits 1-9, check validity, and recurse
hints.hi: Empty cell dhundho, digits 1-9 try karo, validity check karo, aur recurse karo

hints.en: To check validity, ensure the digit doesn't exist in the same row, column, or 3x3 box
hints.hi: Validity check karne ke liye ensure karo ki digit same row, column, ya 3x3 box mein exist nahi karta

approach.en: Find next empty cell, try digits 1-9. For each digit, check if placing it is valid (no conflict in row, column, 3x3 box). If valid, place and recurse. If recursion fails, backtrack.
approach.hi: Next empty cell dhundho, digits 1-9 try karo. Har digit ke liye check karo ki place karna valid hai (row, column, 3x3 box mein koi conflict nahi). Agar valid hai toh place karo aur recurse karo. Agar recursion fail ho toh backtrack karo.

description.en: Given an undirected graph represented as an adjacency matrix and an integer M, determine if the graph can be colored with at most M colors such that no two adjacent vertices have the same color. If yes, print one valid coloring assignment.
description.hi: Ek undirected graph diya hai adjacency matrix ke roop mein aur ek integer M, determine karo ki graph ko at most M colors se color kiya ja sakta hai ya nahi aise ki koi do adjacent vertices ka same color na ho. Agar haan, toh ek valid coloring assignment print karo.

explanation.en: Vertex 0 gets color 1, vertex 1 gets color 2, vertex 2 gets color 3, vertex 3 gets color 2. No two adjacent vertices share a color.
explanation.hi: Vertex 0 ko color 1, vertex 1 ko color 2, vertex 2 ko color 3, vertex 3 ko color 2. Koi do adjacent vertices ka same color nahi hai.

hints.en: Try assigning each color (1 to M) to each vertex and check if adjacent vertices have different colors
hints.hi: Har vertex ko har color (1 to M) assign karne ki koshish karo aur check karo ki adjacent vertices ke colors alag hain

hints.en: Backtrack if no color can be assigned to the current vertex
hints.hi: Agar current vertex ko koi color assign nahi ho pa raha toh backtrack karo

description.en: Given an undirected graph represented as an adjacency matrix, determine whether a Hamiltonian Cycle exists. A Hamiltonian Cycle visits every vertex exactly once and returns to the starting vertex. If it exists, print the cycle.
description.hi: Ek undirected graph diya hai adjacency matrix ke roop mein, determine karo ki Hamiltonian Cycle exist karta hai ya nahi. Hamiltonian Cycle har vertex ko exactly ek baar visit karta hai aur starting vertex pe wapas aata hai. Agar exist karta hai toh cycle print karo.

explanation.en: Starting from vertex 0, we visit 1, 2, 4, 3 and return to 0. Every vertex is visited exactly once.
explanation.hi: Vertex 0 se start karke hum 1, 2, 4, 3 visit karte hain aur 0 pe wapas aate hain. Har vertex exactly ek baar visit hota hai.

hints.en: Start from vertex 0 and try to build a path that visits all vertices
hints.hi: Vertex 0 se start karo aur ek path banane ki koshish karo jo saare vertices visit kare

hints.en: Before adding a vertex, check adjacency and that it's not already in the path
hints.hi: Vertex add karne se pehle adjacency aur path mein already hona check karo

description.en: Given a set of positive integers and a target sum, find all subsets whose elements add up to the target sum. Print all such subsets.
description.hi: Positive integers ka ek set aur ek target sum diya hai. Wo saare subsets dhundho jinke elements ka sum target sum ke barabar ho. Saare aise subsets print karo.

explanation.en: Multiple subsets can add up to 35. For example, 18 + 7 + 10 = 35 and 20 + 15 = 35.
explanation.hi: Kai subsets ka sum 35 ho sakta hai. Jaise 18 + 7 + 10 = 35 aur 20 + 15 = 35.

hints.en: For each element, you have two choices: include it or exclude it
hints.hi: Har element ke liye do choices hain: include karo ya exclude karo

hints.en: Prune branches where remaining sum becomes negative
hints.hi: Un branches ko prune karo jahan remaining sum negative ho jaaye

starterCode.python:

approach.en: Use include/exclude backtracking. At each index, either include current element (if sum doesn't exceed target) or exclude it. Prune when remaining elements can't fill the gap.
approach.hi: Include/exclude backtracking use karo. Har index pe current element ko include karo (agar sum target se zyada nahi hota) ya exclude karo. Jab remaining elements gap fill nahi kar sakte toh prune karo.

code.python:
def subset_sum(arr, target):
    res = []
    def bt(idx, rem, cur):
        if rem==0: res.append(cur[:]); return
        if idx==len(arr) or rem<0: return
        cur.append(arr[idx]); bt(idx+1, rem-arr[idx], cur); cur.pop()
        bt(idx+1, rem, cur)
    bt(0, target, [])
    return res

description.en: Given an M x N grid of characters and a word, determine if the word exists in the grid. The word can be formed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells, where adjacent cells are horizontally or vertically neighboring. The same cell cannot be used more than once.
description.hi: Ek M x N character grid aur ek word diya hai. Determine karo ki word grid mein exist karta hai ya nahi. Word sequentially adjacent cells ke letters se banta hai, jahan adjacent cells horizontally ya vertically neighboring hain. Ek cell ek se zyada baar use nahi ho sakta.

explanation.en: Starting from A(0,0) -> B(0,1) -> C(0,2) -> C(1,2) -> E(2,2) -> D(2,1). All cells are adjacent and no cell is reused.
explanation.hi: A(0,0) se start karke -> B(0,1) -> C(0,2) -> C(1,2) -> E(2,2) -> D(2,1). Saare cells adjacent hain aur koi cell dubara use nahi hua.

hints.en: Start DFS from each cell that matches the first character of the word
hints.hi: Har us cell se DFS start karo jo word ke pehle character se match karta hai

hints.en: Mark cells as visited during traversal and unmark when backtracking
hints.hi: Traversal ke dauran cells ko visited mark karo aur backtracking mein unmark karo

description.en: Given an N x N chessboard, find a sequence of moves for a knight such that it visits every square exactly once. The knight starts from position (0, 0). Print the board with the order in which each square was visited.
description.hi: Ek N x N chessboard diya hai, knight ke liye moves ka aisa sequence dhundho ki wo har square ko exactly ek baar visit kare. Knight position (0, 0) se start karta hai. Board print karo jisme har square ka visit order likha ho.

explanation.en: The knight starts at (0,0) which is marked 1, and makes valid L-shaped moves to visit all 25 squares in order.
explanation.hi: Knight (0,0) se start karta hai jo 1 mark hota hai, aur valid L-shaped moves karke saare 25 squares ko order mein visit karta hai.

hints.en: A knight has 8 possible moves from any position
hints.hi: Knight ke kisi bhi position se 8 possible moves hain

hints.en: Use Warnsdorff's heuristic to choose the next move: pick the square with fewest onward moves
hints.hi: Warnsdorff's heuristic use karo next move choose karne ke liye: wo square choose karo jiske aage sabse kam moves hain

Agar stuck ho toh backtrack karo. Warnsdorff's heuristic performance improve karta hai sabse kam exits wale moves pehle pick karke.
